scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The proved theorem concerns complex Hilbert-space unilateral shifts with a nonnegative three-periodic magnitude pattern. Its constrained minimizers include zero weights; it does not address longer periods, general Banach sequence spaces, or nonperiodic symbols. The cubic spectral reduction and periodic Rayleigh formula are known background. The moment-constrained optimization and sharp coefficient are assessed here. Prior equivalences cannot be completely excluded; independent scientific validation is not performed.
title: A sharp mean–variance envelope for three-periodic weighted-shift numerical radii
